headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 20, 2026**
article:
The Atlanta Braves secured a crucial 8-4 victory over the Miami Marlins, led by Michael Harris II's impressive performance at the plate. Harris II recorded 2 hits, including a home run, and drove in 2 runs in 5 at-bats.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Ben Williamson, who has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays due to a low back strain. Williamson's injury is effective retroactive to May 17, 2026. Other notable injuries include Lance McCullers Jr. (Houston Astros) and James McCann (Arizona Diamondbacks).

The Tampa Bay Rays made a significant trade addition, acquiring 3B Oliver Dunn from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for LHP Joe Rock on May 19, 2026. Dunn joins the Rays' roster in a key move.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 4-3. Travis Bazzana led the Guardians' offense with a strong performance, recording 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Orioles 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-1 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Kevin Kelly earning the win and Bryan Baker notching the save.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Phillies 4-1**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Chase Burns leading the way on the mound. Burns pitched 6.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Rays Place Williamson on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays second baseman Ben Williamson has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a low back strain, effective retroactive to May 17, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rays Make Key Trade Addition**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays acquired 3B Oliver Dunn from the Chicago White Sox in exchange for LHP Joe Rock on May 19, 2026. Dunn joins the Rays' roster in a significant move.
